verdict.rationale: HumanLayer clearly supports end-to-end autonomous coding sessions (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented workflows) that implement tasks using agents like Claude Code and Codex, including structured phases and sub-agents for research/plan/implement, which implies substantial feature work can be delegated (humanlayer-docs-6, humanlayer-docs-9, humanlayer-docs-10, humanlayer-docs-14). However, no evidence explicitly confirms the agent writes or runs tests as part of the workflow, and no hands-on account demonstrates a full feature-plus-tests delivery. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or example showing test generation/execution as part of the implementation flow, and independent verification of end-to-end feature completion including tests.
